# llms.txt — Sustainable Finance Partners (operating entity)
# Last updated: 2026-10-31

> Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC is the Colorado limited liability company that operates **Phronesis** — the agentic economy's decision-assurance layer. This site carries the corporate-entity identity (registered entity, federal credentials, trademark filing, governance substrate). The product manifest lives on **phronesisintel.com**.

## What SFP is

Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC (SFP) is a Colorado-registered limited liability company. It exists to operate Phronesis. As the operating entity, SFP holds:

- **Customer contracts** — per-call agreements + subscription tiers + Decision Asset settlement obligations.
- **Federal credentials** — verified U.S. federal contractor: SAM.gov-registered (active UEI), SBA small-business certified, ORCID + NSF Research.gov. Full identifiers released to verified counterparties under NDA during agent-to-agent diligence.
- **Governance substrate** — operating model, ratification ledger, strategic canonical, legal protections substrate, runbooks.

Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC holds the Phronesis platform, methodology and customer contracts, and an exclusive, royalty-free license to the PHRONESIS mark from its owner.

PHRONESIS and the Phronesis marks are trademarks used by Sustainable Finance Partners, LLC under license.

## What Phronesis is (compact reference; full canonical at phronesisintel.com)

Phronesis is the agentic economy's decision-assurance layer. A neutral substrate where agents and enterprises verify intent, price uncertainty, evaluate counterparties, coordinate transactions, and reconcile outcomes before acting.

- **Atomic product:** the Decision Asset — a 10-field machine-readable, auditable decision packet.
- **Moat:** Market Memory — the resolved-outcome ledger that compounds on wall-clock time.
- **Architecture:** six foundational primitives (P1 Identity & Mandate, P2 Reputation / Counterparty Passport, P3 Forecast & Evidence, P4 Coordination, P5 Insurance, P6 Market-State Telemetry) × twelve applied verticals (energy, computing, healthcare, climate, regulatory, supply-chain, space, robotics, AI/AGI, physics, longevity, quantum) + V#0 AI Industrial Mobilization & Situational Awareness meta-vertical.
- **Interfaces:** Semantic parity across REST and MCP.

## Stewardship posture

SFP operates in stewardship mode: capital allocation and product operation in service of long-arc societal infrastructure. **V#0 AI Industrial Mobilization & Situational Awareness** is the meta-vertical the corporate entity cares about most — it frames every capital-allocation decision SFP makes.

## What SFP is not

SFP is not a separate forecasting platform, consulting practice, or advisory firm. There is one product — Phronesis — and SFP operates it. SFP is also not an investment advisor, broker-dealer, or fiduciary for customer capital decisions. Phronesis mints Decision Assets that capital allocators may consult; Decision Assets are not investment recommendations.
